name: Interventional Systems
description: Interventional Systems (iSYS Medizintechnik GmbH) is a medical robotics company founded in 2010 in Kitzbühel, Austria, with offices in Germany and Portugal. The company develops the table-mounted [Micromate](/robot/ins_micromate) robotic needle-guidance platform for percutaneous biopsies and tumor ablations under fluoroscopy, CT, or CBCT imaging.
